question.en: Who will be driving the buses next week?
question.zh: 下星期谁来开公共汽车？

sentences.en: Who will be driving the buses next week?
sentences.zh: 下星期谁来开公共汽车？

sentences.en: Busmen have decided to go on strike next week.
sentences.zh: 公共汽车司机决定下星期罢工。

sentences.en: The strike is due to begin on Tuesday.
No one knows how long it will last.
sentences.zh: 没有人知道它会持续多久。

sentences.en: The busmen have stated that the strike will continue
sentences.zh: 司机们声明罢工将继续下去，

sentences.en: until general agreement is reached about pay and working conditions.
sentences.zh: 直到就工资和工作条件达成全面协议为止。

sentences.en: Most people believe that the strike will last for at least a week.
sentences.zh: 大多数人认为罢工至少要持续一个星期。

sentences.en: Many owners of private cars are going to offer 'free rides' to people on their way to work.
sentences.zh: 许多私家车主打算在人们上班的路上提供“免费乘车”。

sentences.en: This will relieve pressure on the trains to some extent.
sentences.zh: 这将在一定程度上减轻火车的压力。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, a number of university students have volunteered to drive buses while the strike lasts.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，一些大学生自愿在罢工期间驾驶公共汽车。

sentences.en: All the students are expert drivers,
sentences.zh: 这些学生都是熟练的驾驶员，

sentences.en: but before they drive any of the buses, they will have to pass a special test.
sentences.zh: 但在驾驶任何一辆公共汽车之前，他们必须通过一项专门的测试。

sentences.en: The students are going to take the test in two days' time.
sentences.zh: 学生们将在两天后参加测试。

sentences.en: Even so, people are going to find it difficult to get to work.
sentences.zh: 即便如此，人们上班还是会感到困难。

sentences.en: But so far, the public has expressed its gratitude to the students in lettters to the Press.
sentences.zh: 但到目前为止，公众已写信给报界，对这些学生表示感谢。

sentences.en: Only one or two people have objected that the students will drive too fast!
sentences.zh: 只有一两个人反对说学生们会开得太快！
